**Replacing Calibre**: the last everyday jobs you needed Calibre for now live in Bookbench — editing many books at once, looking up metadata, and seeing what you have read. This release collects 2.3-beta1 to beta3.

## New

- **Edit several books at once** in the Metadata area: select with Ctrl/Shift+click (or in the library, right-click > *Edit metadata of n books*). The form shows shared values and *(various)* where books differ; only fields you type into change; authors, tags and list fields can *replace*, *add* or *remove*. Every change is shown in a preview first.
- **Several books ▾**: *Number series …*, *Search and replace …* (plain text or regular expression), *Author sort from authors*.
- **Published**: a field for the publication date (`dc:date`), also as a library column, in the Calibre comparison and the Calibre import.
- **Look up metadata**: Google Books and Open Library hits with covers; tick per field what to take — title, authors, publisher, date, language, ISBN, tags, subtitle, blurb, cover. Goes through several selected books one by one.
- **Language for look-ups**: pick it per search or set a preferred one (*Settings > Books > Blurbs*). Another language than the book's searches without the ISBN and only finds editions in that language — e.g. German blurbs for English books. Also used by *Look up all missing blurbs* and Claude's source profiles.
- **Reading state from KOReader** (read only): status, progress, rating, highlights, reading time and last read; library column *Read status*, optional *Last read* and *Reading time*, filters *Unread*, *Currently reading*, *Finished*, *On hold*. A library on your computer remembers the state each time its e-reader is connected.
- In the library, *Remove advert text* works on all selected books.
- Fixes: after syncing, the status bar sometimes showed the reload message instead of the sync result.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
